N-maitre.objects: Banach spaces E1,E2; fixed nonlinear map K; U and its image family V.
N-maitre.fixed_and_variable: K and spaces fixed; u varies and v=K(u).
N-maitre.hypotheses: K maps bounded sets into relatively compact sets; U L1 bounded; compositions strongly measurable; V subset Lp, bounded Lr, and uniform target-Lp translations.
N-maitre.equations: The Lr family bound and translation limit identify output E2 and exact domains.
N-maitre.quantifiers: One auxiliary r works for the entire family; r need not equal p.
N-maitre.conclusion: Image-family relative compactness in Lp(E2); continuous representatives at infinity.
N-maitre.status: Published theorem with an explicit r=infinity consequence on a finite interval.
N-maitre.local_definitions: The map compactness property is spelled out; no continuity, injectivity or monotonicity is silently assumed.
